title: aye meri behan dukhiya zainab
body:
ay meri behan dukhiya zainab
akbar na raha asghar na raha abbas sa bhai qatl hua
ab tere hawale hai kunba
<<MINI>>
hai sabr tujhe karna zainab
ay meri behan...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo zakhmi kaleja akbar ka hulqoon chida wo asghar ka
har lamha tujhe yaad aayega
<<MINI>>
hai sabr tujhe karna zainab
ay meri behan...
<<DIVIDER>>
farwa ko sahara dena hai kubra ko dilasa dena hai
har gaam ek maqtal hoga
<<MINI>>
hai sabr tujhe karna zainab
ay meri behan...
<<DIVIDER>>
kat jayega ab mera bhi gala hoga laasha pamaal mera
naize ki ani par sar hoga
<<MINI>>
hai sabr tujhe karna zainab
ay meri behan...
<<DIVIDER>>
chin jayegi tere sar se rida jal jayega bistar abid ka
tu hogi rasan basta behna
<<MINI>>
hai sabr tujhe karna zainab
ay meri behan...
<<DIVIDER>>
bemaar pisar sajjad mera zanjeer may jakda jayega aur tauq may hoga uska gala
<<MINI>>
hai sabr tujhe karna zainab
ay meri behan...
<<DIVIDER>>
mazloom meri pyasi bachi zaalim ke tamache khayegi
rassi may bandhega uska gala
<<MINI>>
hai sabr tujhe karna zainab
ay meri behan...
<<DIVIDER>>
gir jayenge unton se bache aur goonjenge unke naale
koi na sunega unki sada
<<MINI>>
hai sabr tujhe karna zainab
ay meri behan...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab zakhm liye jaana hai watan allah tera haafiz hai behan
ab jaata hai ran ko bhai tera
<<MINI>>
hai sabr tujhe karna zainab
ay meri behan...
<<DIVIDER>>
bechain thi zainab sunke rasheed ho jayega pyasa bhai shaheed
tha sheh ke labon par ye noha
<<MINI>>
hai sabr tujhe karna zainab
ay meri behan...
